caption: The drawing depicts a two-handled cup, centrally positioned and outlined in black line on a plain, off-white background. The cup has a broad, slightly flared body that narrows towards a short, cylindrical base with two horizontal bands. Each side of the cup has a symmetrically curved handle extending outward and upward before returning inwards to meet the base, both handles ending in a small curled tip. A small rectangular mark or symbol appears near the upper left side of the cup. Beneath the cup image, in cursive and decorative script, there is an inscription: "The gift of Mrs. Abigail Beech to the Church in Milford July ye 6 Anno Domini 1719." The artist’s signature, "Lawrence Hynes," appears in cursive below and to the right of the cup. There are no other objects or additional colors in the drawing.
title: Two Handled Beaker
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
